popCulture.title: Minotaur
popCulture.description: Theseus' Attic cycle still orbits the labyrinth — the tribute ship, Ariadne's thread, and the bull-man under Knossos.

popCulture.title: Theseus
popCulture.description: Athens' culture-hero remains the unifying king of the cycle — robber-slayer, labyrinth victor, and founder of the synoikismos.
